privacyModal.title: Privacy Policy
privacyModal.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Berg See Home ("we", "us") collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you use our website and booking services.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: When you make a booking or contact us, we collect information such as your name, email address, phone number, postal address, country, and payment details necessary to process your reservation.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use your information to process bookings, communicate with you about your stay, handle payments, and comply with legal obligations such as local guest registration requirements.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.body: We retain your booking and guest data for as long as necessary to fulfil your stay. After your check-out date, we keep your data for one month, after which it is permanently deleted from our systems.

sections.heading: Payment Information
sections.body: Payments are processed securely by our payment provider (Stripe). We do not store your full card details on our servers.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: We use cookies to remember your language and currency preferences. You can manage your cookie preferences at any time.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data. To exercise these rights, please contact us using the details below.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us via the contact details provided on this website.

cookieConsent.message: We use cookies to remember your language and currency preferences. Do you allow us to store these cookies?

amenities.subtitle: Everything included in your stay at Berg See Home
amenities.description: This spacious apartment is comprised of 1 living room, 2 separate bedrooms and 1 bathroom with a bath and free toiletries. The fully equipped kitchen features a refrigerator, a dishwasher, kitchenware and a microwave. Featuring a balcony with lake views, this apartment also offers a tea and coffee maker and a flat-screen TV. The unit offers 5 beds.
